description: Implementation of the BufferPool class for Metal renderer in ANGLE project, managing GPU buffers including allocation, deallocation, and reuse strategies.

classes.name: BufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of GPU buffers for efficient memory allocation and reuse in Metal renderer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer pool with specified size, alignment, and maximum buffer count.

methods.name: allocateNewBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a new GPU buffer, respecting maximum buffer limits and reusing free buffers if possible.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a segment within the buffer pool, possibly creating a new buffer if needed.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Finalizes current buffer allocations, unmaps buffers, and moves them to in-flight list.

methods.name: releaseInFlightBuffers
methods.description: Releases buffers that have finished GPU usage, moving them to the free list.

methods.name: destroyBufferList
methods.description: Clears a list of buffers and updates allocation count.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys all buffers and resets the pool.

methods.name: updateAlignment
methods.description: Updates the memory alignment requirement for buffer allocations.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the buffer pool.
